statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ b : ℕ, 2≤b → ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range b → 2≤D.card → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, let S := (Finset.range (b^k)).filter (fun n : ℕ => (∀ i < k, (n/b^(i))%b ∈ D) ∧ ∀ i, i+1<k → (n/b^(i))%b≠(n/b^(i+1))%b); (((S).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n))).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(1+(S.card:ℝ))^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在相邻位必须不同的数字族内部控制哥猜例外。
plain_statement.en: Establish an intrinsic saving for digit strings forbidding equal adjacent digits.

brief.zh: 邻位依赖破坏独立乘积。用带频率的转移矩阵替代标量因子，按允许词的实际个数归一化。
brief.en: Use frequency-dependent transition matrices in place of independent digit factors.
